name: Frozen Zigzag

clear.progressFormula: progress% = 100 * itemsSoldAtSalesStand / maxDropItemCount (StageProgressionManager.OnSalesStandSell / MaxDropItemCountInStage). maxDropItemCount = sum over blocks of 6 drops.
clear.cashbackNote: Cashback conditions require StageLevel>=2, so they are inactive in stage 1. Usage = cash spent during the stage / cashTarget.

grid.coords: Cells are integer (x,z); +x = east (screen right), +z = north (into the quarry, away from the camera). Every rect here is normalised to its min corner (x,z) + size w,h in cells (90/270 rotation already applied to building footprints). In the raw StageJson, ore groups store their top-left cell (minX,maxZ) instead - already converted. worldCenter = ((x + w/2 - 500) * 2.5 + offset) INFERRED: the original world origin is unknown, only relative placement matters. One block = one cell = 2.5 world units.
